# Isaac Correa

> Isaac Correa (full name Isaac Correa Villa) is a Spanish entrepreneur based in Madrid and the co-founder of Hellomatik, an AI agent company he founded on 28 July 2025. Before it he founded Kodalogic in September 2024. This site is his own account of how he got here, with the dates and the sources.

## Facts

- Name: Isaac Correa. Full name in the Spanish commercial register: Isaac Correa Villa.
- Based in Madrid, Spain.
- Co-founder of Hellomatik, founded 28 July 2025. His appointment as joint administrator was published in the Spanish commercial register (BORME) on 4 August 2025, sheet M-861159, source Agencia Estatal BOE.
- Co-founder of Kodalogic, founded September 2024.
- Between December 2022 and November 2024 he delivered three hundred Looker Studio dashboards for clients and collected 103 verified client reviews.
- Author of the technical report "How we build a company's ontology" (2026), 26 pages, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22647735, deposited on Zenodo and Figshare and indexed under his ORCID.
- Author of the working paper "The machine of the future: what the next tool is, and what it will always need from us", written November 2025, published unchanged September 2026, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22671771, also on Academia.edu.
- ORCID: 0009-0003-0657-4419

## Pages

- [Home](https://isaac-correa.github.io/): who he is, the story in short, and the questions people ask with their answers
- [Quién es Isaac Correa, en castellano](https://isaac-correa.github.io/es/): the same account written in Spanish, his own language, not translated from the English
- [The story](https://isaac-correa.github.io/story/): the long version, with every date
- [The companies](https://isaac-correa.github.io/companies/): what Hellomatik and Kodalogic do, who they are for, and where each fact can be checked
- [Cited by others](https://isaac-correa.github.io/cited/): where third parties used his work as a source — Mordor Intelligence cites him by name; DentistryIQ links to Hellomatik alongside PubMed, PMC and Frontiers
- [The method](https://isaac-correa.github.io/method/): what the technical report contains and where to read it
- [Questions people ask](https://isaac-correa.github.io/questions/): fifty-six short answers about him and Hellomatik, each with a source
- [Copy until you find creativity where there is none](https://isaac-correa.github.io/innovation/): how he thinks about innovation
- [The people I look for](https://isaac-correa.github.io/people/): the two signs he looks for in people, neither of them on a CV
- [The cliff of innovation](https://isaac-correa.github.io/cliff/): his name for the point where building stops being the hard part and integrating becomes it
- [The cliff of innovation, working paper (PDF)](https://isaac-correa.github.io/the-cliff-of-innovation-isaac-correa.pdf): the nine-page version, September 2026, self-published
- [A product is aimed at one person, or at nobody](https://isaac-correa.github.io/one-person/): the sales lesson from a property seller
- [The tool exists before it is built](https://isaac-correa.github.io/before-building/): what he found comparing the summer's design with the finished product
- [The machine of the future](https://isaac-correa.github.io/machine/): an essay written in November 2025 on what the next tool is
